headline_marked: Aamir Khan to [[marry Gauri Spratt on July 5]], opting for a private ceremony
headline: Aamir Khan to marry Gauri Spratt on July 5, opting for a private ceremony
summary: The Bollywood star will have a registered marriage at his home with only close family and friends in attendance.
details: Bollywood actor Aamir Khan is set to enter a new chapter of his life by marrying Gauri Spratt on July 5. The actor has expressed his desire to keep the wedding a simple and private affair rather than a star-studded event.
The ceremony will be a registered marriage taking place at Aamir's own residence. Only immediate family members from both sides and a few close friends will be invited to the event.

Aamir first introduced Gauri Spratt to the media during his 60th birthday celebrations last year. He admitted to their relationship at the time and later stated they were ready to take their relationship to the next step.

Gauri Spratt is a Bengaluru-based professional working in the wellness, beauty, and lifestyle sectors. She is the granddaughter of Philip Spratt, a British-born thinker of the Indian independence movement.

Gauri has a son from a previous marriage. Aamir and Gauri have known each other for many years, though their romantic relationship began in 2024 and they have reportedly been living together for over a year.

This will be the actor's third marriage. He was previously married to Reena Dutta, with whom he has two children, Junaid and Ira. He was later married to filmmaker Kiran Rao, with whom he has son Azad Rao Khan.

Aamir maintains a friendly relationship with Kiran Rao for the co-parenting of their son. He is currently taking a break from acting to prepare for the wedding, but may soon return with a sequel to '3 Idiots' under director Rajkumar Hirani.

headline_marked: Secret tunnel in bathroom: [[Actress Boby's husband arrested]]
headline: Secret tunnel in bathroom: Actress Boby's husband arrested
summary: Police discovered a hidden passageway in the bathroom of the suspect's residence during the raid.
details: Police have arrested the husband of Bangladeshi film actress Boby, following a raid on his residence.
During the search, law enforcement officers discovered a secret tunnel leading from the bathroom, which was reportedly used as a hideout.
The arrest took place after a series of investigations into the actor's spouse's activities.
Further details regarding the charges and the specific nature of the crimes are being processed by the authorities.
